description: With the hub down, opening Invite → Human on the replica shows the HUB_UNAVAILABLE alert directly under Create invitation (before the person did anything) while the history stays at "Loading…" indefinitely. The alert says "retry this attempt" but there is no Retry button; Create invitation stays enabled and clicking it changes nothing visible.
expected: The history area says it cannot load while the hub is unreachable, with a Retry; Create is disabled with the reason.
actual: Contradictory Loading… plus an unrelated-looking create error.
suggested_fix: Scope the error to the history section, replace Loading… with the error and a Retry, and disable Create when the hub is unreachable.

description: The creator's history includes invites sponsored by other members (Marcus's invite to Sofia appears as a plain "Human · Waiting to be used" row) with no sponsor column, and she can revoke it. Invite rows returned by the API have no sponsor field at all.
expected: Rows show "by Marcus Lee" for invites the creator did not issue.
actual: Priya cannot tell her invites from Marcus's.

description: On a non-creator replica the heading "Invitations for this project" lists only the viewer's own invites ("None yet." for Marcus, although Priya has many).
expected: Heading reads "Your invitations for this project".
actual: Heading implies the full project list.

description: With the hub down, the header shows "Remote presence unavailable" next to "Saved locally · synced".
expected: Sync indicator says the hub is unreachable (e.g. "Saved locally · hub unreachable").
suggested_fix: Use hubConnected in the status label.
